$comment: Director script for ?director=1 (start at a scene with &scene=<n or id>). Keys: → or PageDown next, ← or PageUp previous, space pause, z zoom, c captions, Home first scene. Scene fields: id, caption (required); kicker, sub; title (full-screen card); code (caption in the code font); focus (a directory or file path, a list tried in order, or @hot / @sigma / @landing / @selected; null or absent shows the whole map); highlight (paths or directories to outline, or @landing / @needs; more than 40 files dims the rest); emphasize (hero, stats, sigma, vaccine, funnel, trunk); requires (vaccine, landing, review, sigma: the scene is skipped while the colony has none); tab (events, intents, review, why: opens the side panel); select (a file for the Why tab, or @landing / @hot); duration (seconds, auto-advance). Captions fill {colony} {files} {violations} {fixed} {agents} {working} {landings} {perMin} {decisions} {reflex} {human} {review} {sigma} {recall}.

scenes.caption: A colony, not a queue.
scenes.sub: Git coordination for thousands of coding agents, built on Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects and Artifacts.

scenes.caption: Every tile is a file in {colony}.
scenes.sub: {files} files. Size is bytes; color is the field the agents read.

scenes.caption: One person declares one architecture rule.
scenes.sub: Every violation becomes a need in the field: {violations} to fix, and no one assigns them.

scenes.caption: Agents read the field, not each other.
scenes.sub: Needs attract, claims repel, trails fade. {working} agents are working right now.

scenes.caption: Each call goes to the cheapest layer that is sure.
scenes.sub: Clef decision models first, then an LLM, then a person. {reflex} of {decisions} decisions stayed at the reflex layer.

scenes.caption: Lanes land non-conflicting changes together.
scenes.sub: Every read is validated against trunk. A stale read goes back with the exact delta. {perMin} landings a minute.

scenes.caption: {violations} violations left. {fixed} fixed.
scenes.sub: No queue, no scheduler, no lock. The colony repairs toward the shape it was given.

scenes.caption: Only uncertainty reaches a person.
scenes.sub: A rejection becomes an antibody, and the next similar change is caught without anyone.

scenes.caption: Review is tested with sealed bad changes.
scenes.sub: The colony seeds deliberately broken changes and measures how many review catches: recall {recall}.

scenes.caption: Every commit carries its why.
scenes.sub: Intent, rule and approver, agent and model, decisions, checks, and what was not verified, in git notes on Artifacts.

scenes.caption: When rebases cascade, sigma rises past 1.
scenes.sub: The governor slows the lanes and closes admission until the colony calms. Sigma now: {sigma}.
